title: Museum of Antioquia
geometryBasis: The eight-point named museum ring places the full block and chamfered corners. The Qualla plan and municipal written description fix organization around the two main courtyard openings.
sectionBasis: The regional conservation report describes the projected two-material perimeter with an axial tall entrance and stepped terraces. The verified court photographs establish pale wall and pier rhythms and the two visible basin forms. All section heights are estimates.
limitations: The eight-point outer block is mapped. Courtyard widths and rear lightwells are read approximately from the creator’s location diagram. Roof heights, exterior window details, color and exact grade at the perimeter are estimated from the written survey and available evidence.
The model covers the current palace and open court envelopes. Museum interiors, temporary fittings, sculptures, Plaza Botero and the separate Palace of Culture are outside scope.
